content.answer_markdown:
The Research Tilt on this Recommendation (run 1, version 1) uses 19 approved research Insights across 13 tilt entries, all marked "within the bound". Each entry below shows the Report passage(s) behind it and the proposed tilt:

- **bond (-2.0 pp):** RPT-HV-HARBOR-Q4-2026 p.2 "We are cautious on bonds." and RPT-UBS-GIRY-2026 p.7 "Long bonds and Treasury bills gave lower returns, although they beat inflation." (the second is classed neutral)
- **equity (+1.5 pp):** RPT-UBS-GIRY-2026 p.7, on equities as the best-performing asset class.
- **Energy (-1.5 pp):** RPT-FID-Q2-2026 p.3 "Indicators suggest negative risk-reward."
- **Consumer Staples (-1.3 pp):** RPT-FID-Q2-2026 p.3 and RPT-HV-MERIDIAN-Q4-2026 p.1 "We are negative on Consumer Staples."
- **Health Care (+1.0 pp):** RPT-HV-NORTHWIND-Q4-2026 p.1 "Our Investment Committee is overweight Health Care." The RPT-FID-Q2-2026 p.3 passage is neutral.
- **Financials (+0.5 pp):** RPT-HV-MERIDIAN-Q4-2026 p.1 "We are positive on Financials." The RPT-FID-Q2-2026 p.3 passage is also positive.
- **Industrials (+0.5 pp):** RPT-HV-HARBOR-Q4-2026 p.1 "We favour Industrials." The RPT-FID-Q2-2026 p.3 passage is also positive.
- **Information Technology (+0.3 pp):** RPT-FID-Q2-2026 p.3 "Solid fundamentals and compelling valuations after a sell-off."
- **Consumer Discretionary (+0.2 pp):** RPT-FID-Q2-2026 p.3 "Forward valuation measures show positive risk-reward."
- **Communication Services (-0.1 pp), Materials (-0.1 pp) and Utilities (-0.1 pp):** each rests on a single RPT-FID-Q2-2026 p.3 passage.
- **Real Estate (0.0 pp):** the passages conflict. RPT-HV-NORTHWIND-Q4-2026 p.1 is underweight and RPT-FID-Q2-2026 p.3 is positive, so the tilt is held at zero.

The engine bounds every tilt at 2.0 pp. The Report passages only provide the direction and support, and the engine sets the size.
